lessons.rule: Exact-SHA is required before knowledge reuse
Confidence decays and skills require revalidation
Provenance is part of the lesson, not metadata afterthought
Personal memory transfers knowledge only, never authority or permissions
Promotion requires trials, independent challenge and rollback path
Replay must capture exact SHA, input, strategy, memory snapshot, environment and oracle
External/device evidence remains an explicit oracle boundary
Product failures must create root-cause memory links

antiLessons.rule: Do not promote from repair-applied text alone
Do not use stale skills as permanent truth
Do not resolve contradictions by confidence score alone
Do not import authority through memory bundles
Do not infer real-device PASS from software PASS
Do not recreate the retired 200-bot pool as a routing shortcut
